title: Pearl Landing Timer
description: A customizable HUD timer that shows when your latest thrown ender pearl will land.
body: # Pearl Landing Timer Pearl Landing Timer is a mod that shows a configurable HUD countdown for your latest thrown ender pearl. It helps you see when your pearl is predicted to land, with options for seconds or Minecraft ticks. ## Features | Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | Pearl landing countdown | Shows a timer for your latest thrown ender pearl. | | Timer display modes | Display the countdown in seconds or Minecraft ticks. | | Configurable HUD | Move the timer HUD to your preferred screen position. | | Optional visuals | Toggle the pearl icon and background on or off. | | Mod Menu support | Configure the mod from the Mod Menu settings screen. | ## Supported Platforms & Versions | Platform | Supported Versions | | :--- | :--- | | Fabric | 1.21.x | --- ## Disclaimer This mod is licensed under the **[MIT License](https://github.com/oneauraaa/pearl-landing-timer/blob/main/LICENSE)**.
